subject: NeuTra kickoff — fast posterior sampling for the Bayesian toolkit
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kickoff for NeuTra. The open-source release gives us neural-transport HMC: train an IAF bijector to warp away bad posterior geometry, then run HMC in the transformed space. The neutra_runner reproduces the flagship result on the 100-dimensional funnel target — a distribution plain HMC basically cannot traverse — with both IAF and affine baselines.

Product: a NeuTra preset inside the efficiency portfolio's Bayesian inference toolkit, so internal users stop hand-tuning step sizes on nasty posteriors. Deliverables: (1) runner productized with our config system, (2) benchmark suite (funnel + two internal calibration posteriors) with tuned defaults, (3) toolkit docs.

Milestones: runner ported by end of March, benchmarks by mid-May, toolkit release before window close 06-08. One dependency: the internal calibration posteriors come from datasets that are moving in the Corpus v2 migration, so let's get our data pulls sorted early.

Zofia
